holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: ICICI Bank received a GST show cause notice on September 30, 2026, for Rs 229.14 crore plus applicable interest and penalty.
Anup Bagchi resigned as ICICI Life MD and CEO effective October 13, 2026, with Sidharatha Mishra appointed as his successor from October 14, 2026.
The Securities Appellate Tribunal set aside an earlier secretarial portal access order involving the bank.

holdings.why_it_matters: ICICI Bank is the fund's largest holding at 8.46% weight. Its 3-month return of -3.30% generated an estimated contribution of -0.279%, amplifying the fund's concentration in Financials (33.4% of total AUM).

watch.text: The bank is scheduled to announce its Q2 financial results alongside sector peers.

holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: HDFC Bank appointed Anup Bagchi as MD and CEO for a three-year term effective October 27, 2026.
The bank reported advances of Rs 33,075 billion and deposits of Rs 33,275 billion as of September 2026.
Foreign institutional investors reduced their stake in the bank by 2.4% during the September quarter.
Jigar Shah took over as General Counsel from October 1, 2026, following the superannuation of Sudhir Kumar Jha.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 3.96% fund weight, HDFC Bank's sharp 3-month drop of -14.27% made it the fund's largest detractor, with an estimated contribution of -0.565%.

watch.text: The bank is lined up to report its Q2 earnings.
Anup Bagchi assumes charge as incoming MD and CEO on October 27, 2026.

holdings.name: Zomato Ltd

what_changed.text: Quarterly sales reached Rs 20,211 crore and net profit stood at Rs 92 crore in the quarter ended June 2026.
The company received an ESG score of 76.00 and was placed in the Leader band for FY2026.
The CBIC clarified that application-based consumer platforms will face a 5% GST rate regardless of business model.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 3.74% weight in the fund, Zomato gained 11.67% over 3 months, delivering an estimated +0.436% contribution and serving as the second-largest positive driver.

watch.text: Founder Deepinder Goyal discussed product developments ahead of the launch of the Temple wearable.

holdings.name: ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Ltd.

what_changed.text: Sidharatha Mishra resigned from the board on October 5, 2026, and Anindya Banerjee was appointed additional non-executive director from October 6, 2026.
The asset management company acquired over 0.5 million sq ft of office space in Bengaluru for Rs 626 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: At 3.70% of the portfolio, the stock fell -4.09% over 3 months, deepening the drag from the fund's 33.4% financial sector exposure.

watch.text: The board meets on October 12, 2026, to approve Q2 and H1 results and evaluate an interim dividend.

holdings.name: Infosys Ltd

what_changed.text: Infosys confirmed it expects no material impact from the U.S. Department of Labor's suspension of PERM applications.
The firm partnered with Columbia University to establish an enterprise AI center and research collaboration on October 1, 2026.
Infosys extended its strategic AI-driven IT transformation collaboration with ABN AMRO using Infosys Topaz.

holdings.why_it_matters: Infosys holds a 3.63% fund weight. Its 3-month decline of -4.18% and 6-month drop of -20.82% weighed on the fund's 17.0% Technology basket.

watch.text: The company continues monitoring the U.S. PERM program application freeze.

holdings.name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd

what_changed.text: L&T PT&D secured multiple mega EPC orders across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and India on October 5, 2026.
L&T Energy CarbonLite received an LNTP for a 2x800 MW thermal power plant in Chandrapura, Jharkhand.
The timeline to dispose of its stake in L&T Metro Rail Hyderabad was extended to December 31, 2026.
Four officials were promoted to senior management positions effective July 1, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 3.62% weight, L&T's 3-month return of -6.15% weighed on performance across the fund's 15.1% Industrials allocation.

watch.text: Project execution continues across newly secured Gulf and domestic mega EPC contracts.
The stake disposal of L&T Metro Rail Hyderabad faces an extended deadline of December 31, 2026.

holdings.name: Interglobe Aviation Ltd

what_changed.text: CRISIL maintained its AA-/A1+ ratings on watch developing for Rs 9,000 crore bank facilities.
The airline posted June 2026 quarter sales of Rs 24,584 crore and a net loss of Rs 238 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Representing 3.51% of fund assets, its -9.02% 3-month decline detracted an estimated -0.317%, making it the third-largest performance drag.

watch.text: CRISIL is monitoring the developing watch status on the carrier's Rs 9,000 crore bank facilities.

holdings.name: Bajaj Finance Ltd

what_changed.text: The company issued a notice for an EGM on November 2, 2026, to approve an Rs 11,700 crore QIP and an Rs 5,800 crore warrant issue.
Bajaj Finance increased fixed deposit interest rates by up to 40 bps following the RBI repo rate hike.
The company allotted 51,000 secured NCDs aggregating Rs 510.86 crore on October 9, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 3.27% portfolio weight, the stock declined -5.93% over 3 months, compounding losses across the fund's 33.4% allocation to Financials.

watch.text: The board meets on October 19, 2026, to review and approve Q2 and H1 FY2026-27 financial results.
Shareholder voting on the Rs 17,500 crore total fundraise takes place at the EGM on November 2, 2026.

holdings.name: Tech Mahindra Ltd

what_changed.text: Tech Mahindra scheduled its Q2 FY27 results declaration and earnings conference call for October 15, 2026.
The company completed the liquidation of its step-down subsidiary LCC Networks Poland on October 9, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 2.99% weight, the stock gained 4.08% over 3 months, providing an estimated +0.122% positive contribution to fund returns.

watch.text: Financial results for Q2 FY27 will be announced on October 15, 2026.

holdings.name: Bharti Airtel Ltd

what_changed.text: Airtel rolled out new postpaid plans featuring bundled annual international roaming from October 8, 2026.
Airtel Business introduced IQ Gateway, an enterprise communications platform designed for DPDP compliance.
The Department of Telecommunications levied monetary penalties for subscriber verification violations.

holdings.why_it_matters: Accounting for 2.87% of the portfolio, the stock declined -6.00% over 3 months, exerting a moderate drag on performance despite steady 57% operating margins in June 2026.

watch.text: The carrier monitors market response and ARPU impact from its updated postpaid tariffs.

portfolio.statement: Invesco India Large Cap Fund fell 4.29% over the past 3 months as severe sell-offs in major private lenders and aviation outweighed gains in select technology positions.
interp: The fund's 33.4% allocation to Financials proved to be the primary performance headwind as HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, and Bajaj Finance all dropped over the 3-month period.
Technology holdings provided selective relief, led by top contributor Coforge (+24.21%) and Zomato (+11.67%), but could not fully offset broad large-cap declines.
portfolio.line: Sharp drawdowns across core banking and airline positions overshadowed steady performance from technology and platform businesses.

drivers.text: HDFC Bank fell 14.27% over 3 months, generating an estimated -0.565% return drag following FII stake sales and executive turnover.
Zomato rose 11.67% over 3 months, adding an estimated +0.436% contribution as sales grew to Rs 20,211 crore.
Larsen & Toubro declined 6.15% over 3 months despite receiving new mega international EPC contracts and domestic thermal power orders.

themes.title: Financial Intermediation and Rate Dynamics
themes.text: With 33.4% in Financials, fund returns are heavily exposed to banking loan growth, liability costs, and capital structure changes.
holdings: ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Ltd.

themes.title: Enterprise and Consumer Technology
themes.text: A 17.0% allocation to Technology spans traditional IT delivery, enterprise AI initiatives, and hyper-growth consumer platforms.

themes.title: Infrastructure and Fleet Operations
themes.text: Industrials account for 15.1% of the fund, linking performance to capital goods execution and domestic aviation volumes.

macro.why: Higher benchmark interest rates pushed Bajaj Finance to raise fixed deposit rates by up to 40 bps, influencing cost of funds.
The U.S. DOL suspension of PERM processing introduces regulatory scrutiny around skilled visa processing for Indian IT service providers.

priced_in.text: The leadership change at HDFC Bank appointing Anup Bagchi as MD and CEO effective October 27, 2026.
Bajaj Finance's planned Rs 17,500 crore capital raising through warrants and a QIP ahead of its November 2, 2026 EGM.

could_change.title: Resolution of Aviation Debt Rating Watch
could_change.text: CRISIL's rating resolution on InterGlobe Aviation's Rs 9,000 crore bank facilities currently on watch developing could alter debt financing costs.

could_change.title: Prolonged U.S. Labor Certification Freezes
could_change.text: If the U.S. PERM suspension extends longer than expected, it could create operational frictions for IT personnel deployment.

portfolio.risk_note: The fund maintains a concentrated 33.4% exposure to Financials and 39.8% in its top 10 positions. Significant weakness across marquee lenders like HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank directly dampens fund-level returns, limiting the shielding effect of positive performers in other sectors.
